newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Lujiazui to make 4-for-10 bonus issue.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Lujiazui to make 4-for-10 bonus issue.

text.p: Real estate developer Shanghai Lujiazui Finance & Trade Zone Development plans to make a four-for-ten bonus issue to all shareholders, a company statement said on Tuesday.
The plan has been approved by a meeting of the company's shareholders, the statement said.

After the issue, Lujiazui will have a total of 1,334.06 million shares, including 800.8 million state shares, 54.6 million shares held by institutions, 114.66 million domestic A shares and 364 million B shares, it said but gave no more details.
